expected_census_delta.core_corpus_note: No mantra, Work or TextVersion is created, deleted or relabelled. RV 10552 / SV 1844 / YV 1975 / AV 5839 = 20210 is untouched; 20,210 of them gain one property.
expected_census_delta.the_absolute_census_is_volatile_this_spr: baseline_census is read live at build time and other agents are importing concurrently: the sprint baseline recorded 117,970 / 282,389 and this build read 127404 / 295700. Verify this delta as a DELTA -- +9 nodes, +27 relationships -- against whatever the census reads immediately before the apply, not against the absolute figures below. The ritual layer itself has not moved: Ritual 103, Object 41, Offering 21, RitualRole 11, USES_OBJECT 23, PERFORMED_BY 16, RECEIVES_OFFERING 0, ritual_context 0, yupa 6 mantras over 2 Vedas -- every figure this artifact rests on was re-read at build time.

two_step_layers_untouched.statement: Neither layer is written, merged or cross-populated by anything here. HAS_STEP remains the Samhita's own numbering and HAS_RITUAL_STEP the Sutra procedural layer.

no_rite_global_sequence: No ordering relation is proposed. Procedure order stays source-work local, and the PERFORMED_BY edges carry no position.

probable_material_withheld.statement: Not one PROBABLE row is promoted. The four PROBABLE rite-object rows touching the three objects GAP-RITUAL-003 names were read individually and one of the four survived the read.

predicate_declaration.why: The type was already declared and carried zero edges, so nothing had ever measured its range. The wider range admitted exactly the wrong-endpoint error that cost HELD_BY 2,052 edges. Measured before narrowing: all 21 registry offerings carry :Offering, and the nine that are also :Animal or :Substance carry both, so the narrow range removes no reachable recipient.

rights.source: DCS Vedic Prose Corpus, corpus/VPC/, commit 8aeed5a1343d0e48b64eb32af8c00e8c6eb29359
rights.why_not_cc_by: The DCS repository's express CC BY 4.0 grant lives in dcs/data/readme.md and is scoped to 'the data of the DCS and any data in child directories'. corpus/VPC/ is not a child of dcs/data/, so no express licence covers the digitisation. Recording CC BY 4.0 here would attribute a grant to a party without standing to make it, and a wrong licence recorded is worse than none.
rights.second_basis_facts_are_not_copyrightable: What lands in the graph is facts -- that a role exists, that a deity receives an offering, that a mantra is cited in a rite. A fact is not copyrightable whatever the licence of the source it was read from.
rights.third_basis_bounded_evidential_quotation: Each edge carries one cited line and, where held, one attributed translation sentence, with its citation. This is what the project already does for Whitney and Griffith.
rights.the_bound: NO BULK VPC TEXT LANDS IN THE CANONICAL GRAPH. The proposed delta carries 21 evidential quotes across 24 distinct cited lines, out of 61,393 in the corpus, and no property update carries any supplementary text at all -- the 20,210 ritual_context rows carry a citation and a work key, never a line.

properties.supplementary_attestation_note: 91 lines of the eighteen acquired ritual works carry an audumbara- form and 0 of them attest the amulet. Every one is udumbara WOOD: the audumbari post of the sadas, the audumbara camasa, the audumbari asandi, the audumbara danda, the audumbara paridhi, the audumbara plough. The previous value, 91, was correct for the alias and wrong for this node, which is the AVS 19.31 amulet. This is an assessed zero, not an unexamined one.

property_corrections.why: A4-RITUAL-D5. This is the one defect in this domain a user can currently see: a live property asserting 91 lines of corroboration the corpus does not give.

registry_edits.why: The mention layer reads aliases_sa; the graph node property mirrors it.

ritual_registries.RITE_CANDIDATES registers SATTRA with the prefix `sattrayan` and the exact forms sattram / sattrasya / sattre / sattrani / sattranam, all double-t. The Sankhayana edition prints the single-t `satram`, which no registered form reaches, so the only rite alias that fired on the line was `diksit`.
registry_edits.why_an_overlay_and_not_an_edit: data/staging/ritual/manifest.json carries a sha256 for every file beside it. A correction made in place would break 25 hashes and the seal's only value is that they still verify. The overlay is consulted after the sealed registry, is additive by construction, and a test re-hashes the sealed files to prove they did not move.
